# Lembaranzzz
> Self-Hosted Credential & Note Vault — v1.0.1

## About
Lembaranzzz is a self-hosted, zero-knowledge credential manager. Data is encrypted locally with AES-GCM 256-bit + Argon2id before storage. No cloud, no tracking, no account required. Runs as a TUI (Terminal User Interface) via the `lembaranzzz` command.

## Project Structure (Standalone)

```
/
  packages/
    core/ — @lembaranzzz/core — Encryption engine & storage adapters (Atomic Writes)
    cli/  — @lembaranzzz/cli  — TUI (Ink/React) + CLI commands
```

### Build & Run
- Root manifest: `package.json` (Consolidated dependencies)
- Launch TUI (Dev): `bun packages/cli/src/main.ts`
- Binary name: `lembaranzzz`
- Build verification: `tsc --noEmit` on both components.

## Core Package Architecture (`packages/core/src/`)

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `Vault.ts` | Cryptography engine (AES-GCM 256, Argon2id 64MB) |
| `Archive.ts` | High-level CRUD for credentials & notes |
| `Sentinel.ts` | Rate limiting & constant-time compare |
| `storage/FileAdapter.ts` | JSON-file storage adapter (Atomic Writes) |
| `index.ts` | Public API barrel export |

## Critical AI Rules

### ⚠️ Vault Contexts
Lembaranzz uses two main contexts:
1. `saku`: Global vault (`~/.lembaranzz/saku.json`)
2. `pelataran`: Local project vault (`./.lembaranzz-db.json`)

### Error Pattern
All async functions return `Result<T>` — never throw:
```typescript
type Result<T> = { data: T; error: null } | { data: null; error: Error };
```

### Security Parameters (OWASP)
- **Argon2id**: Memory 64MB, Iterations 2, Parallelism 1.
- **AES-GCM**: 256-bit key, 12-byte IV.
- **Storage**: Atomic write-to-temp-then-rename to prevent corruption.

## CLI Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `lembaranzzz` | Launch TUI (default) |
| `lembaranzzz setup` | Interactive setup wizard |
| `lembaranzzz monitor` | System health & integrity |
| `lembaranzzz security` | Security dashboard |
| `lembaranzzz launch` | Enter TUI mode |

## Dev Commands

```bash
bun packages/cli/src/main.ts                  # Run CLI directly
bunx tsc --noEmit --project packages/cli/tsconfig.json # Type Check CLI
bunx tsc --noEmit --project packages/core/tsconfig.json # Type Check Core
```

---
*Stay Secure. Stay Local.*
